name: Dexter's Laboratory
description: Dexter, a boy-genius with a secret laboratory, constantly battles his sister Dee Dee, who always gains access despite his best efforts to keep her out, as well as his arch-rival and neighbor, Mandark.

videos.title: Dexter's Laboratory
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee test his latest invention: a device that turns people into animals, which yields crazy results.

videos.title: The Big Sister
videos.overview: When Dee Dee eats an experimental cookie of Dexter's design, she grows extremely tall and makes the city her dollhouse, leaving it up to Dexter to don his giant Robo-Dexo suit and bring her back.

videos.title: Old Man Dexter
videos.overview: Dexter wants to use his Hydro-Cosmetic Accelerator to age himself enough so he could watch late night television without his parents objecting.

videos.title: Dumb Like Dee Dee
videos.overview: After working himself too hard, Dexter's brain snaps.

videos.title: Ego Trip
videos.overview: When Dexter is attacked by Robots hunting "The one who saved the future", he becomes fascinated by the possibility of what he will be in several years time, taking the Time Machine. Dexter arrives in the future where he finds many things have changed...and that his greatest invention holds the key to total tranquility around the world, but in the hands of evil, also holds the key to total domination of the world

videos.title: Rude Removal
videos.overview: Dexter invents the Rude Removal System, a machine to remove the rudeness from Dee Dee.

videos.title: DeeDeemensional
videos.overview: In "Deedeemensional", Dee Dee time-travels to save Dexter from a monster. In "Magmanamus", Monkey goes up against a lava being that dislikes human-caused noise. In "Maternal Combat", when his mother falls, Dexter creates a robot mom to substitute for her.

videos.title: Dial M for Monkey: Magmanamus
videos.overview: Monkey must defend the city from a giant underground lava monster, Magmanamus, who cannot sleep because of the noise created by its residents.

videos.title: Maternal Combat
videos.overview: When his mother falls ill, Dexter creates a robot to do her chores. Dee Dee gets hold of its remote control and wreaks havoc, forcing Dexter to create a second robot to counter Dee Dee's.

videos.title: Dexter Dodgeball
videos.overview: Dexter is forced to play dodgeball by his P. E. teacher. Constantly failing, Dexter builds a robotic exoskeleton to defend himself.

videos.title: Dial M for Monkey: Rasslor
videos.overview: Intergalactic wrestling champion Rasslor challenges Earth's superheroes, including Monkey, with the planet's fate at stake.

videos.title: Dexter's Assistant
videos.overview: In need of an assistant to operate his latest invention, Dexter performs a brain transplant on Dee Dee to make her smart enough to fulfill the role. With her new brain, Dee Dee proves to be more intelligent than Dexter.

videos.title: Dexter's Rival
videos.overview: Mandark Astronomanov, a new student at Dexter's school, seems to be superior to Dexter academically. Mandark forces Dexter to shut down his lab so that Mandark's lab can gain more power. However, with the help of Dee Dee, Dexter manages to destroy Mandark's lab.

videos.title: Dial M for Monkey: Simion
videos.overview: Monkey encounters Simion, an intelligent anthropomorphic chimpanzee who seeks vengeance on humans for turning him into his current state.

videos.title: Old Man Dexter
videos.overview: Banned from watching a late-night movie due to his young age, Dexter uses his technology to artificially grow into adulthood, but Dee Dee tampers with his machine, causing Dexter to turn into an old man.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Dee Dee and her friends, Lee Lee and Mee Mee, enter Dexter's lab and wreak havoc. Dexter clones himself to stop them, but the girls too make clones of themselves.

videos.title: Dial M for Monkey: Barbequor
videos.overview: Monkey's birthday party is interrupted by Barbequor an intergalactic villain who plans to eat the planets, and his sidekick, the Silver Spooner.

videos.title: Changes
videos.overview: Rerun of "Dexter's Laboratory", the first "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

videos.title: Jurassic Pooch
videos.overview: To clone a dinosaur with an incomplete DNA sequence, Dexter uses his dog's genetic code to fill in the gaps.

videos.title: Dial M For Monkey: Orgon Grindor
videos.overview: While on a date with Agent Honeydew, Monkey gets hypnotized by the music of the Organ Grindor who commands him to rob Fort Knox.

videos.title: Dimwit Dexter
videos.overview: Due to overworking his brain, Dexter's mind shuts down, making him act idiotic.

videos.title: Dee Dee's Room
videos.overview: After Dee Dee steals his critical invention, Dexter ventures into her room to find it.

videos.title: Dial M For Monkey: Huntor
videos.overview: Monkey encounters an alien hunter named Huntor and must fight him to save Agent Honeydew and Commander Chief.

videos.title: The Big Sister
videos.overview: Rerun of the second "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

videos.title: Star Spangled Sidekicks
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee enter tryouts to become Major Glory's sidekick. When Dee Dee wins, Dexter realizes that fancy costumes are not the only criterion to become a superhero.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: TV Super Pals
videos.overview: With only one television in their apartment, Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen disagree on what to watch: Major Glory's televised capture of the Disgruntled Postman, TV Puppet Pals, or the monster truck pull.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee's father buys a video game for them to play, but the game sucks Dexter inside when he plugs in the cartridge, and it is up to Dee Dee to bring him out.

videos.title: Babysitter Blues
videos.overview: Dexter has a crush on his teenage babysitter Lisa. When he finds out that she has a boyfriend, he sabotages their relationship and accelerates his age by ten years in an attempt to win her heart.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Valhallen's Room
videos.overview: Valhallen loses his magic ax and starts turning into a nerd, forcing Major Glory and Krunk to enter his room to find it.

videos.title: Dream Machine
videos.overview: When Dexter's nightmares become frequent and problematic, he invents a machine that allows him to have nice dreams, as long as Dee Dee can operate it properly while she is awake.

videos.title: Dollhouse Drama
videos.overview: Suspicious that Dee Dee has not entered his lab even once on a particular day, Dexter shrinks himself and enters her room to spy on her. He soon becomes an unwilling character in Dee Dee's doll story, but he believes the story to be real.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Krunk's Date
videos.overview: While fighting Comrade Red and his gang, Krunk falls in love with his equivalent in their gang, She-Thing.

videos.title: The Big Cheese
videos.overview: Dexter's new device allows him to study for the next day's French test while sleeping. It malfunctions, causing a single phrase -omelette du fromage- to repeat throughout the night, causing Dexter to wake up the next morning speaking nothing else except "omelette du fromage".

videos.title: Way of the Dee Dee
videos.overview: Dee Dee teaches Dexter how to live life her way instead of being lonely and purely focused on science.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Say Uncle Sam
videos.overview: Major Glory forces Krunk and Valhallen to tidy up their apartment for his Uncle Sam, who is coming over for a visit.

videos.title: Tribe Called Girl
videos.overview: To learn more about girls, Dexter camouflages himself and enters Dee Dee's room, where she is having a sleepover with her friends Lee Lee and Mee Mee. He gets caught by the girls, who force him to take part in their activities.

videos.title: Spacecase
videos.overview: To prevent himself from being taken away by aliens for experimentation, Dexter tricks Dee Dee into going instead, but he regrets his decision after realizing how much he cares for her.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Ratman
videos.overview: To fix their apartment's plumbing, Krunk and Valhallen go to the basement, where they meet Ratman, a diminutive vigilante raised by rats (a parody of Batman).

videos.title: Dexter's Debt
videos.overview: Dexter's lab is threatened with repossession unless he can repay his debt to NASA. When Dee Dee wins the same amount in a lottery, he decides to steal her money out of desperation.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Bee Where?
videos.overview: Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen try to rid their apartment of a bee.

videos.title: Mandarker
videos.overview: Following the destruction of his lab by Dexter and Dee Dee (in the episode Dexter's Rival), Mandark turns to magic to beat Dexter at the science fair.

videos.title: Inflata Dee Dee
videos.overview: Dee Dee inflates Dexter's hydro-plasmatic suit and constantly floats in the air, prompting Dexter to bring her down.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Can't Nap
videos.overview: After fellow Justice Friend White Tiger helps Valhallen stop a super-villain, the latter invites him to spend the night in his apartment, forgetting that Major Glory is allergic to cats.

videos.title: Monstory
videos.overview: Not interested in hearing Dee Dee's long-winded story, Dexter gives her a silencing formula to keep her quiet, but it instead turns her into a giant monster still bent on telling her story. When he realizes that nothing can make her quiet, he becomes a giant monster himself.

videos.title: Beard to be Feared
videos.overview: After a fright from Dee Dee, Dexter lays down in the beard growing machine and tries to grow a beard like his hero, Action Hank. Unfortunately, everyone thinks he's a hero.

videos.title: Quackor the Fowl
videos.overview: Mandark doesn't know that his pet duck is really Quackor the Fowl, Monkey's rival. Quackor overhears Mandark talking in his sleep about destroying Dexter's lab and tries to do it, unaware that Monkey is Dexter's pet.

videos.title: Ant Pants
videos.overview: Dexter prevents Dee Dee from destroying some ants. In order to teach her about ants, Dexter and Dee enter Dexter's ant farm. The ants think Dexter is a criminal and has him fight to the death with a stronger ant.

videos.title: Mom and Jerry
videos.overview: Dexter switches his brain with a mouse, and must avoid his mother when she decides to exterminate him. A Parody of Tom and Jerry.

videos.title: Chubby Cheese
videos.overview: At the Chubby Cheese pizza restaurant, Dexter wears a Chubby Cheese hat and tries to slow down the Whack The Weasel machine to win a stuffed Monkey doll before Dee Dee does.

videos.title: That Crazy Robot
videos.overview: One of Dexter's robots becomes Dee Dee's servant when she removes a wrench that froze him up, but the robot is willing to destroy anyone who is mean to her or scolds her, including Dexter.

videos.title: D & DD
videos.overview: When Dexter's friends tire of the complicated traps he sets up as Dungeon Master (he has their character's killed every time), they put Dee Dee in charge for a change of pace.

videos.title: Hamhocks and Armlocks
videos.overview: Dexter's father gets challenged to an arm wrestling match against a local champion at a truck stop, when he causes the champion to lose for the first time, but refuses to do so even when he trashes the family car. He finally accepts the challenge when he slams the door in Mom's face. Dee Dee knows he'll get creamed, so Dexter builds him a robotic arm to help him win the match.

videos.title: Hunger Strikes
videos.overview: Dexter uses radiation therapy so he can like vegetables, it actually causes him to only eat vegetables, also, the therapy has consequences if Dexter goes too long without them. He turns into a Parody of The Incredible Hulk without vegetables.

videos.title: The Koos is Loose
videos.overview: Dee Dee's imaginary friend comes to life and annoys Dexter. Dexter ends up wishing him away, then he realizes he made a terrible mistake.

videos.title: Morning Stretch
videos.overview: Dexter oversleeps and still has to finish his homework along with getting ready for school and eating breakfast, so he creates a helmet that expands thirty seconds into thirty minutes, but realizes that slowing down time is more detrimental than helpful. When he gets everything done, the helmet shuts off. But Dee Dee blocks his door causing him to miss the bus. When Dexter asks Dee Dee why, she replies "Snow Day, school's canceled!". Dexter realizes he did all that rushing around for nothing!

videos.title: Dee Dee Locks and the Ness Monster
videos.overview: Dee Dee Locks and the Ness Monster—Dexter's mother forces Dexter to read to Dee Dee when she's sick, but she makes up her own story after being bored by Dexter's story (which was actually a science article). The story is completely mixed up and makes no sense. Dexter ends up catching Dee Dee's illness.

videos.title: Backfire
videos.overview: Dexter fuses Dee Dee with the family car by accident, causing mayhem. A Parody of Herbie the Love Bug.

videos.title: Book 'Em
videos.overview: Dexter accidentally takes a library book without checking it out, so he and Dee Dee try to put it back without being caught.

videos.title: Sister's Got a Brand New Bag
videos.overview: Dee Dee's new dance annoys Dexter to no end.

videos.title: Shoo, Shoe Gnomes
videos.overview: Dexter calls upon the "shoe gnomes" to repair his boots, but can't rid himself of them afterwards. The only way to get rid of them, according to Dee Dee, is to kick them in the butt. Dexter gets rid of the last one with his boot, but it's damaged again.

videos.title: Lab of The Lost
videos.overview: Dexter ends up in the "old part of the lab" where his earliest inventions, long since forgotten, are not too happy to see him. They are mad at him for saying they were his greatest inventions, then moved on to another great invention.

videos.title: Labels
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee label everything in the house. When their parents get home, they mistake Dexter for Dee Dee (he had a Dee Dee label on his forehead), but he already blamed Dee Dee for the chaos.

videos.title: Game Show
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee compete against each other on a game show. Where Dexter can't seem to win.

videos.title: Fantastic Boyage
videos.overview: Dexter tries to inject himself into Dee Dee to find a cure to the common cold, but ends up inside his dog. He believes Dee Dee has been infected with a dog virus. He is then mistaken for the first human virus to infect a dog by the vet.

videos.title: Filet of Soul
videos.overview: When Dee Dee refuses to flush their gold fish down the toilet, the ghost of the fish haunts them.

videos.title: Golden Diskette
videos.overview: Dee Dee and Dexter win a free pass to Professor Hawk's magic factory after finding the golden diskette.

videos.title: Snowdown
videos.overview: Dad encourages Dexter to become the king of snow, as he was in his early days, until someone beated him.

videos.title: *Figure Not Included
videos.overview: In an attempt to be popular with his ""friends"", Dexter makes his own Mayor Glory Action Figure.

videos.title: Mock 5
videos.overview: In a whole parody of ""Speed Racer"", Dexter and Mandark compete on a race.

videos.title: Ewww That's Growth
videos.overview: Dexter can't get into a roller coaster because he's too small so he makes himself taller.

videos.title: Nuclear Confusion
videos.overview: Dee Dee steals the nuclear atom that Dexter needs to make his invention work, but she doesn't know that it will explode if Dexter doesn't find it on time.

videos.title: Germ Warfare
videos.overview: Everybody except Dexter gets sick, so he makes himself a plastic bubble to get germ protection.

videos.title: A Hard Day's Day
videos.overview: It's not a great day for science when Dexter has bad luck due to the position of the stars.

videos.title: Road Rash
videos.overview: Mom makes Dexter go outside and ride a bike, thing that turns into a Dexter-Dee Dee chase.

videos.title: Ocean Commotion
videos.overview: While at the beach, Dee Dee (who's wearing a mermaid swimsuit) gets captured by a maniac sailor so Dexter must rescue her.

videos.title: The Bus Boy
videos.overview: Dexter must go to the back of the school bus to retrieve his pencil, where another kid got lost years ago.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Things that go Bonk in the Night
videos.overview: Krunk stays awake all night watching The Puppet Pals Show Marathon, so his brain starts playing him tricks.

videos.title: Ol' McDexter
videos.overview: Dexter is sent to summer camp, in a place far away from civilization.

videos.title: Sassy Come Home
videos.overview: While the family is at the woods, Dexter goes searching for the Mighty Bigfoot, if Dee Dee doesn't find him first.

videos.title: Photo Finish
videos.overview: Dee Dee photographs Dexter's secret lab.

videos.title: Star Check Unconventional
videos.overview: Dexter and two friends go to the Star Check Convention, but certain confusion might send them to a different one.

videos.title: Dexter is Dirty
videos.overview: To avoid the bath, Dexter decides to laminate himself.

videos.title: Ice Cream Scream
videos.overview: Dexter will do anything to make the ice cream vendor stop to get some ice cream.

videos.title: Decode of Honor
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee get their Action Hank and Pony Puff Secret Codes mixed up.

videos.title: World's Greatest Mom
videos.overview: Dexter newest creation gives Mom super powers.

videos.title: Ultrajerk 2000
videos.overview: Dexter's robot takes over his lab.

videos.title: Techno Turtle
videos.overview: Dexter heals a turtle by giving him loads of modern, techno stuff.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: Dexter makes himself invisible to make sure Mom and Dad give him what he wants for his birthday, the Ultimate Mayor Glory Action Figure.

videos.title: Got Your Goat
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee go to South America in order to find the chupacabras, an animal that Dexter created.

videos.title: Dee Dee Be Deep
videos.overview: Dee Dee, who's not exactly good at singing, gets Dexter's help on getting a better voice, but not the voice Dexter was expecting.
When Dexter's favorite show gets interrupted by an emergency, he searches all town trying to find it and solve so regular broadcast returns.

videos.title: Down in the Dumps
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee go to the dumps to retrieve Dee Dee's lost teddy bear.

videos.title: Unfortunate Cookie
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee get trapped with a Finger trap.

videos.title: The Muffin King
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee must stop Dad from eating Mom's muffins.

videos.title: Picture Day
videos.overview: Dexter finds out he's ugly, so he transforms his face to look better for the school photo.

videos.title: Now That's a Stretch
videos.overview: Dexter combines himself with bubble gum to become more stretchable.

videos.title: Dexter Detention
videos.overview: Dexter is send to detention after a confusion during a test.

videos.title: Don't Be a Baby
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee want to become older, but instead they make everyone else a baby.

videos.title: Dial M For Monkey: Peltra
videos.overview: A new female villian named Peltra wants Monkey's Coat.

videos.title: G.I.R.L. Squad
videos.overview: Dee Dee, LeeLee and MeeMee become crimefighters, but of course they will not actually fight crime.

videos.title: Sports a Poppin'
videos.overview: Dad wants to show Dexter the joy of sports.

videos.title: Koos a la Goop a Goop
videos.overview: Koosy tells Dee Dee that he is the king of the land of Koos, but when Dee Dee goes there...

videos.title: Project Dee Dee
videos.overview: Dee-Dee refuses any kind of help from Dexter on her science project, when Dee-Dee shows Dexter her show-and-tell product, he criticises it heavily and offers his own..contributions

videos.title: Topped Off
videos.overview: Surprised of the results coffee causes on Mom and Dad, Dexter and Dee Dee decide to try it themselves.

videos.title: Dee Dee's Tail
videos.overview: Dexter uses his science to turn Dee Dee into a horse.

videos.title: No Power Trip
videos.overview: Dexter overloads the energy of the laboratory, so he makes numerous tries to reload it.

videos.title: Sister Mom
videos.overview: After Dexter did something really bad at school, he gets her mother called, so to not ruin his reputation, he turns Dee Dee into Mom.

videos.title: The Laughing
videos.overview: After Dexter gets bitten by a clown, he turns into one every night.

videos.title: Dexter's Lab: A Story
videos.overview: On his way home, Dexter gets followed by a labrador, when he teaches him to speak, the dog becomes even more annoying.

videos.title: Coupon for Craziness
videos.overview: A confusion at the supermarket makes Dexter go home with a different, yet extremely scientific, family; but who is home with his real family?

videos.title: Better Off Wet
videos.overview: Dexter is afraid of taking a dive at the pool because Dad always pushes him.

videos.title: Critical Gas
videos.overview: After Dexter eats a giant burrito he believes he's going to die, so he makes a list of everything he must do before that time comes. (Including, make Mom and Dad happy, do dishes, free Robots, make World Peace, end World's hunger, learn to dance, make Dee Dee happy, shut down the Main System... and tell Mom and Dad about the secret laboratory).

videos.title: Let's Save the World You Jerk!
videos.overview: Dexter and Mandark must team up in order to save the Earth from a meteor rain.

videos.title: Average Joe
videos.overview: After an I.Q. test defines Dexter as ""average"", he decides to live an average life hanging out with an average boy of last name Smith.

videos.title: Rushmore Rumble
videos.overview: Dexter and Mandark mechanize the giant figures of Lincoln and Washington from the Mount Rushmore statues and wreak havoc with them.

videos.title: A Boy and His Bug
videos.overview: Dexter creates a small bug that eats all the scrap metal caused by Dee Dee's destruction.

videos.title: You Vegetabelieve It!
videos.overview: Dexter's untested formula causes all plants in the garden to become dangerous.

videos.title: Aye Aye Eyes
videos.overview: After Dexter returns a bunny to a little girl with big round eyes, she starts following Dexter everywhere.

videos.title: Dee Dee and the Man
videos.overview: After Dexter ""fires"" Dee Dee, he realizes that his lab needs chaos.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: Dexter travels to the past to meet the caveman that discovered fire.

videos.title: Don't Be a Hero
videos.overview: Dexter attempts to make numerous accidents to get super powers.

videos.title: My Favorite Martian
videos.overview: Dexter goes to Mars to find alien life forms.

videos.title: Paper Route Bout
videos.overview: Dee Dee and the Ninja Clan battle for who delivers the newspapers in the neighborhood.

videos.title: The Old Switcharooms
videos.overview: After Dexter and Dee Dee destroy Dad's bowling trophy, they are sent to each other's room.

videos.title: Trick or Treehouse
videos.overview: Dee Dee builds a treehouse in the garden and Dexter can't stop wondering what's up there.

videos.title: Quiet Riot
videos.overview: Dexter worked all night on his inventions so all he wants is some sleep, but Dee Dee will make sure that that doesn't happen.

videos.title: Accent You Hate
videos.overview: Dexter and his friends Lucky and Pierre(¿?) are victims of a bully that hates kids with funny accents.

videos.title: Catch of the Day
videos.overview: Numerous factors like getting up early, being the first ones there, fishing clothes and other accesories, will not allow Dexter and his Dad to go on a fishing trip.

videos.title: Dad is Disturbed
videos.overview: Constant interruptions by Dexter, Dee Dee and Mom will not let Dad watch his golf game.

videos.title: Framed
videos.overview: After Dexter breaks his glasses, he starts a new fashion at school.

videos.title: That's Using Your Head
videos.overview: Dexter meets a bum at an appliance store with a strange device on his head.

videos.title: DiM
videos.overview: Dexter goes to the appliance store to buy a lightbulb for his lab.

videos.title: Just an Old Fashioned Lab Song...
videos.overview: Dexter takes piano classes from a man that looks a lot like Paul Williams.

videos.title: Repairanoid
videos.overview: When an electricist comes to repair the house, Dexter discovers that if he repairs the lab it will function perfectly.

videos.title: Sdrawkcab
videos.overview: Dexter creates a belt that can have its wearer do everything backwards, only to get in trouble when Dee Dee manages to get control of the time directional switch.

videos.title: The Continuum of Cartoon Fools
videos.overview: Dee Dee keeps getting into Dexter's lab even though Dexter keeps throwing her out.

videos.title: Sun, Surf, and Science
videos.overview: Mandark tries to impress Dee Dee by getting into a surfing contest.

videos.title: Big Bots
videos.overview: Dexter makes Dee Dee a robot for herself, at the same time a volcano is going to burst on an island in the middle of the ocean.

videos.title: Gooey Aliens that Control Your Mind
videos.overview: Dexter must save his family after they get possesed by aliens.

videos.title: Misplaced in Space
videos.overview: Dee Dee must save Dexter who is a slave in a distant galaxy.

videos.title: Dee Dee's Rival
videos.overview: Dee Dee and Lalavava (Mandark's sister), compete on a ballet contest.

videos.title: Pslyghtly Psycho
videos.overview: It's Mother's Day and Mom can't take that Dad, Dee Dee and Dexter do all the housework.

videos.title: Game for a Game
videos.overview: Dexter and Dee Dee compete in various games chosen by Dexter.

videos.title: Blackfoot and Slim
videos.overview: A documentary shows the secret lives of Dexter and Dee Dee, also known as Blackfoot and Slim.

videos.title: Trapped with a Vengeance
videos.overview: Dexter stays at school too much, forcing the janitor to stay as well, so he waits for a day in which Dexter has to leave early for an emergency, as he plans his revenge...

videos.title: The Parrot Trap
videos.overview: Dexter must stop his mechanical parrot before his imitations reveal the secret of his lab.

videos.title: Dexter and Computress Get Mandark!
videos.overview: Dexter and Computress team up in order to shrink Mandark's head.

videos.title: The Justice Friends: Pain in the Mouth
videos.overview: Krunk gets a nacho stuck in his tooth and Mayor Glory wants to take it out himself while Valhallens insists on taking Krunk to the dentist.

videos.title: Dexter Vs. Santa's Claws
videos.overview: Dexter must prove to Dee Dee that Santa Claus doesn't exist.

videos.title: Dyno-Might
videos.overview: When Blue Falcon appears with a destroyed Dynomutt, Dexter decides to build a new one.

videos.title: LABretto
videos.overview: The story of how Dexter was born and how he built his lab, in the style of a musical.

videos.title: Last But Not Beast
videos.overview: Dexter must save Japan from being destroyed by a monster, but his robot must be controlled by four people to function correctly, so Dexter must tell Dee Dee... and his parents.

videos.title: Streaky Clean
videos.overview: Dexter creates a device to keep his clothes clean.

videos.title: A Dad Cartoon
videos.overview: Dad decides to give the car a retouch.

videos.title: Sole Brother
videos.overview: After a failed mutation experiment, Dexter becomes Dee Dee's foot.

videos.title: Mind Over Chatter
videos.overview: Dexter uses a device to listen to what Dad is thinking, but the experiment backfires and everyone else can hear what Dexter is thinking.

videos.title: A Quackor Cartoon
videos.overview: Quackor returns to battle Monkey in Dexter's Lab.

videos.title: Momdark
videos.overview: Mandark disguises as Mom in order to get into Dexter's Lab.

videos.title: Copping an Attitude
videos.overview: Because of his exceptional grades Dexter's school and parents have decided that he can go to college. At first Dexter is happy to be there so he can fill his mind with college knowledge, but in the end the students influence on Dexter allows him to do college pranks sending him a one way ticket back to Huber Elementary School.

videos.title: A Failed Lab Experiment
videos.overview: Dexter creates a device taht doesn't work the way he wanted.

videos.title: The Grand Daddy of All Inventions
videos.overview: Dexter's mom takes him to his grandpa's house. At first he thinks it's going to be a boring day until he discovers that his grandpa has a secret lab!

videos.title: Poppa Wheely
videos.overview: It's career day and Dexter is ashamed of his Dad so he creates a Dad that looks more like him.

videos.title: A Mom Cartoon
videos.overview: Mom spends a day at the supermarket.

videos.title: The Mock Side of the Moon
videos.overview: Dexter travels to the moon and finds aliens that are planning to come to Earth to take everything.

videos.title: If Memory Serves
videos.overview: Fearing that his memory might be limited, Dexter uses a device to save all his memories.

videos.title: A Mandark Cartoon
videos.overview: Mandark plans another scheme to get rid of Dexter.

videos.title: Tele Trauma
videos.overview: Tired of missing his favorite TV shows because of studying, Dexter creates a special helmet that absorbs all the TV info.

videos.title: A Boy Named Sue
videos.overview: How did a young child called Susan became the being now known as Mandark? Born to free spirits, and with a passionate determination to harness the forces of science for his own ends, this is his story...

videos.title: Lab on the Run
videos.overview: Two robots escape from Dexter's lab in order to have a better life.

videos.title: Dos Boot
videos.overview: Mandark gets in Dexters computer raving havok, so Dexter must stop him.
